description: This file defines a generic class 'BroadcastChannelWriter<T>' that implements the 'IBroadcastChannelWriter<T>' interface for publishing items to a broadcast channel within the Orleans framework. It manages subscribers, handles publishing logic with options for fire-and-forget delivery, and includes detailed logging.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelWriter<T>
classes.description: A class responsible for writing/publishing messages to a broadcast channel, managing subscribers, and logging activities within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Publishes an item to all subscribers, either fire-and-forget or awaiting completion based on configuration.

methods.name: PublishToSubscriber
methods.description: Sends an item to a specific subscriber and handles exceptions during the send process.
